title: The reduction of the generic fibre is the fibre of the reduction
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a morphism and a generic point of an irreducible component of the target, the lemma identifies the reduction of the fibre with the fibre of the reduction of the source. The proof compares the two constructions by reducing the fibre product formation step by step, so the content is an identification of two ways of taking a reduction and a fibre, each of which is an elementary operation. Retained author proof at lines 6696-6716.
